snippet.title: RINGS OF POWER SEASON 3: The Stars, The Secrets & The Scandal! London Red Carpet
snippet.description:
MORFYDD CLARK, JAMIE CAMPBELL BOWER, CHARLIE VICKERS & MORE! | THE RINGS OF POWER SEASON 3 UK PREMIERE

London rolled out the red carpet for the spectacular UK premiere of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 and what a night it was!

I was on the red carpet at Queen Elizabeth Hall, catching up with the stars, getting the inside scoop and finding out EVERYTHING about what's coming in the hugely anticipated new season.

Leading the cast was #MorfyddClark, alongside #JamieCampbellBower (Stranger Things), #CharlieVickers, Lloyd Owen, Maxim Baldry, Ismael Cruz Córdova, Sophia Nomvete and many more including the iconic Simon Pegg who has just joined the season 3 cast!

And trust me, there was plenty to talk about! Who's doing what, who's falling in love, who's got their eye on someone – and, perhaps more importantly, who's out to kill someone? I caught up with the cast for all the new-season gossip, secrets and hints about the drama that's about to unfold in Middle-earth.

Season 3 promises to be darker, bigger and more action-packed than ever, with an exciting new chapter, an expanding cast of characters and a battle for the very survival of Middle-earth.

Five years after the fall of Eregion, Sauron's armies are sweeping across the world. The Dark Lord is closer than ever to achieving ultimate domination, as he sets his sights on forging the One Ring to rule them all.

With Middle-earth on the brink of total war, the Elves, Dwarves, Men and Wizards must unite against an enemy who threatens everything.

THE RINGS OF POWER SEASON 3 premieres November 11 on Prime Video.

Watch my exclusive red-carpet interviews, get reacquainted with the cast and discover what the stars revealed about the darker, more dangerous season ahead!

Did I mention Jamie Campbell Bower? Yes, Stranger Things fans, he's there too!

LIKE, SUBSCRIBE AND HIT THE NOTIFICATION BELL for more exclusive premieres, celebrity interviews and behind-the-scenes Hollywood and London entertainment coverage.
